name: itzg Minecraft
author: bnuy@bnuy.dev
description: Full-featured Minecraft server using itzg/docker-minecraft-server. Supports vanilla, Paper, Purpur, Folia, and all other server types. Includes autopause, resource packs, whitelist/ops management, and Aikar JVM flags out of the box.

variables.name: EULA
variables.description: Accept the Minecraft EULA

variables.name: Server Type
variables.description: Server type: VANILLA, PAPER, PURPUR, FOLIA, FORGE, FABRIC, etc.

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: MC version (e.g. 1.21.5). Use LATEST for auto-upgrade.

variables.name: Memory
variables.description: JVM memory allocation (e.g. 2G, 4G)

variables.name: Online Mode
variables.description: Enable Mojang authentication. Disable only for cracked servers.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Server display name (shown in proxy/server list)

variables.name: MOTD
variables.description: Message of the day (shown below server in client list)

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players allowed

variables.name: Plugin URLs
variables.description: Newline-delimited list of plugin URLs to auto-install on startup

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: World difficulty level

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: Default game mode for new players

variables.name: Hardcore
variables.description: Enable hardcore mode

variables.name: PVP
variables.description: Allow player vs player combat

variables.name: Force Default Gamemode
variables.description: Force the default gamemode on player join

variables.name: Allow Flight
variables.description: Allow flying in survival mode

variables.name: Generate Structures
variables.description: Generate villages, temples, and other structures

variables.name: Spawn Animals
variables.description: Allow animal spawning

variables.name: Spawn Monsters
variables.description: Allow monster spawning

variables.name: Spawn NPCs
variables.description: Allow villager spawning

variables.name: Command Blocks
variables.description: Enable command blocks

variables.name: World Seed
variables.description: World generation seed (leave empty for random)

variables.name: World Save Name
variables.description: Name of the world save folder

variables.name: Level Type
variables.description: World generation type (default, flat, largebiomes, amplified)

variables.name: Spawn Protection
variables.description: Spawn protection radius in blocks (0 to disable)

variables.name: Max World Size
variables.description: Maximum world radius in blocks

variables.name: View Distance
variables.description: Server view distance (3-32 chunks)

variables.name: Simulation Distance
variables.description: Simulation distance (3-32 chunks)

variables.name: Player Idle Timeout
variables.description: Kick idle players after N minutes (0 to disable)

variables.name: Pause When Empty
variables.description: Seconds before pausing when empty (1.21.2+, 0 to disable)

variables.name: Legacy Autopause
variables.description: Enable itzg autopause for pre-1.21.2 versions

variables.name: Autopause Disconnect Timeout
variables.description: Seconds before pausing after last disconnect

variables.name: Autopause Initial Timeout
variables.description: Seconds before pausing on fresh start with no connections

variables.name: Autopause Knock Timeout
variables.description: Seconds before pausing after port knock with no connection

variables.name: Resource Pack URL
variables.description: URL to a resource pack to send to clients

variables.name: Resource Pack SHA1
variables.description: SHA1 hash of the resource pack

variables.name: Resource Pack Enforce
variables.description: Force clients to use the resource pack

variables.name: Resource Pack Prompt
variables.description: Message shown when prompting clients to use the pack

variables.name: Enable Whitelist
variables.description: Enable whitelist management

variables.name: Whitelist
variables.description: Comma-separated list of usernames to whitelist

variables.name: Operators
variables.description: Comma-separated list of usernames to op

variables.name: Aikar JVM Flags
variables.description: Use Aikar optimized JVM garbage collection flags

variables.name: Custom JVM Options
variables.description: Additional JVM arguments (space-delimited)

variables.name: JVM -XX Options
variables.description: JVM -XX flags (space-delimited, precede -X options)

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Root logger level

variables.name: Shutdown Warning Delay
variables.description: Seconds to announce before stopping the server

variables.name: Shutdown Timeout
variables.description: Seconds to wait for graceful shutdown

variables.name: Server Icon
variables.description: URL or path to server icon (PNG, 64x64)
